enriched_activities.desc: Lie on the bed with eyes closed. Pull the blanket up over the shoulders. Turn the body onto the right side. Place the left arm under the pillow. Breathe slowly and evenly. Turn onto the back. Extend both legs. Turn onto the left side. Pull the blanket toward the chest. Kick the right foot out from under the blanket. Pull the foot back under the blanket. Roll from the left side onto the stomach. Turn the head to the other side on the pillow. Bend the right arm and rest it beside the head. Straighten the legs. Turn onto the right side again. Keep eyes closed. Remain lying still with slow breathing.

Open eyes. Sit up on the bed. Swing both legs off the bed. Stand up. Walk to the bathroom door. Push the door open. Step inside. Press the light switch on. Turn the water heater switch on. Step into the shower area. Turn the shower tap to the left. Hold the right hand under the water. Adjust the tap to the right. Step under the water. Wet the hair. Pick up the shampoo bottle. Squeeze shampoo into the left palm. Rub both hands together. Apply shampoo to the hair. Rub the scalp with the fingertips. Rinse the hair under the water. Pick up the soap. Rub the soap between both hands. Wash the arms, neck and torso. Rinse the body. Pick up the towel from the hook. Rub the hair with the towel. Wipe the face. Wipe the arms and legs. Turn the shower tap to the right to stop the water. Step out of the shower area. Hang the towel back on the hook. Turn the water heater switch off. Press the light switch off. Open the door. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast, brewing coffee with the kettle
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Press the light switch on. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the milk carton and a box of eggs. Close the refrigerator door. Place them on the counter. Open the cupboard door. Take out a bowl, a plate and a mug. Close the cupboard door. Pick up the egg. Crack the egg on the rim of the bowl. Pull the shell apart over the bowl. Pick up a fork. Beat the eggs with the fork. Turn the induction cooker on. Place a pan on the induction cooker. Pour oil into the pan. Pour the beaten egg into the pan. Stir the egg with a spatula. Turn the induction cooker off. Slide the egg onto the plate. Pick up the bread. Put the bread into the toaster. Press the toaster lever down. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the bread and put it on the plate. Take the kettle. Fill the kettle with water from the tap. Place the kettle on its base. Press the kettle switch on. Open the cupboard door. Take out the coffee jar. Spoon coffee powder into the mug. Close the cupboard door. Pick up the plate and the mug. Sit down on the chair. Cut the egg with the fork. Lift the fork to the mouth. Chew and swallow. Pick up the mug. Sip the coffee. Put the mug down. Continue eating with the fork. Pick up the mug. Finish the coffee. Stand up. Carry the plate and mug to the sink. Place them in the sink. Turn the tap on. Rinse the plate and mug. Turn the tap off.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the arts organization office
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the bedroom. Pick up the work bag from the chair. Put the bag over the left shoulder. Pick up the phone from the desk. Put the phone into the bag pocket. Walk to the front door. Bend down. Put on the left shoe. Put on the right shoe. Tie the shoelaces. Stand up. Open the front door. Step outside. Pull the front door closed. Lock the door with the key. Put the key into the bag. Walk down the stairs. Push the building door open. Step out to the street. Walk to the bus stop. Stand at the bus stop. Take the phone out of the bag. Look at the screen. Put the phone back into the bag. Step onto the bus. Scan the card on the reader. Walk down the aisle. Grip the handrail with the right hand. Stand near the door. Step off the bus at the stop. Walk two blocks along the sidewalk. Turn right at the corner. Walk to the office building entrance. Push the glass door open. Step inside.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as an arts administrator: meetings, scheduling exhibitions, coordinating artists and budgets
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the desk. Put the bag down beside the chair. Sit down on the chair. Press the computer power button on. Type the login password on the keyboard. Open the email application. Click through the inbox messages. Type replies on the keyboard. Stand up. Pick up a notebook and a pen. Walk to the meeting room. Sit down at the table. Open the notebook. Write notes with the pen. Turn the pages of the printed budget sheet. Point at the schedule on the screen. Speak to the colleagues about the exhibition dates. Write down the revised dates in the notebook. Pick up the phone. Dial the artist's number. Hold the phone to the right ear. Talk to the artist about the delivery deadline. Put the phone down on the table. Pick up the pen. Circle a figure on the budget sheet. Stand up. Walk back to the desk. Sit down. Type the meeting notes into the computer. Open the spreadsheet file. Enter the budget figures in the cells with the keyboard. Click save. Pick up the phone. Read a message. Type a reply on the phone screen. Put the phone down. Stand up. Walk to the printer. Pick up the printed documents. Walk back to the desk. Staple the pages together. Place them in a folder.

enriched_activities.activity: Lunch break at a cafe near the office
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the chair. Pick up the wallet and phone. Walk out of the office. Push the glass door open. Walk along the sidewalk. Turn left at the corner. Push the cafe door open. Step inside. Walk to the counter. Stand in the queue. Read the menu board. Order a sandwich and a coffee at the counter. Take the card out of the wallet. Tap the card on the card reader. Put the card back into the wallet. Take the paper cup. Walk to the table by the window. Pull the chair back. Sit down. Unwrap the sandwich paper. Lift the sandwich with both hands. Bite the sandwich. Chew and swallow. Pick up the paper cup. Sip the coffee. Put the cup down. Continue eating the sandwich. Wipe the mouth with a napkin. Stand up. Carry the cup and the wrapper to the bin. Drop the wrapper into the bin. Walk out of the cafe. Push the door open. Walk back along the sidewalk to the office building. Push the glass door open. Step inside.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as an arts administrator: drafting program documents, gallery logistics, correspondences
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the desk. Sit down on the chair. Move the mouse to wake the screen. Open the word processor. Type the program document draft on the keyboard. Scroll the page with the mouse wheel. Highlight a paragraph. Press the delete key. Type a new sentence. Open the gallery floor plan file. Click on the image. Drag the image to enlarge it. Type measurements into the text box. Open the email application. Read the incoming messages. Type a reply to the gallery manager. Attach the floor plan file. Click send. Pick up the phone. Dial the transport company. Hold the phone to the right ear. Talk about the artwork pickup time. Write the time on a sticky note. Put the phone down. Stick the note on the edge of the monitor. Stand up. Walk to the filing cabinet. Pull the top drawer open. Take out a folder. Close the drawer. Walk back to the desk. Sit down. Open the folder. Read the contract pages. Type the contract number into the document. Click save. Stand up. Walk to the meeting room. Sit down. Discuss the budget with the colleague. Nod the head. Stand up. Walk back to the desk. Sit down. Shut the computer down. Stand up. Pick up the bag.

Walk out of the office. Push the glass door open. Walk along the sidewalk. Turn right at the corner. Walk to the bus stop. Stand at the bus stop. Take the phone out of the bag. Look at the screen. Put the phone back into the bag. Step onto the bus. Scan the card on the reader. Walk down the aisle. Grip the handrail with the left hand. Step off the bus at the stop. Walk down the street. Turn left at the corner. Walk to the building entrance. Push the building door open. Step inside. Walk up the stairs. Take the key out of the bag. Insert the key into the lock. Turn the key. Push the front door open. Step inside. Pull the door closed behind. Bend down. Untie the shoelaces. Take off the left shoe. Take off the right shoe. Place the shoes on the rack. Put the key on the hook.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner together with Member 1 on the induction cooker
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Press the light switch on. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the vegetables and the tofu box. Close the refrigerator door. Place them on the counter. Open the cupboard door. Take out a cutting board, a knife and a pot. Close the cupboard door. Turn the tap on. Hold the vegetables under the water. Rub the vegetables with both hands. Turn the tap off. Place the vegetables on the cutting board. Pick up the knife. Cut the vegetables into slices. Push the slices to the side of the board. Open the tofu box. Cut the tofu into cubes. Turn the induction cooker on. Place the pot on the induction cooker. Pour oil into the pot. Add the vegetables into the pot. Pick up the spatula. Stir the vegetables. Turn to Member 1. Say: "Can you hand me the salt?" Take the salt shaker from Member 1. Shake salt into the pot. Put the salt shaker down. Add the tofu cubes into the pot. Stir with the spatula. Press the range hood switch on. Place the lid on the pot. Turn the induction cooker down to a lower setting.

Turn the induction cooker off. Pick up the pot. Pour the food into a serving bowl. Walk to the table. Place the bowl on the table. Walk to the cupboard. Open the door. Take out two plates and two sets of chopsticks. Close the door. Walk back to the table. Place one plate in front of Member 1. Place the other plate at the own seat. Put the chopsticks beside the plates. Pull the chair back. Sit down on the chair. Pick up the chopsticks with the right hand. Pick up food from the bowl. Lift the chopsticks to the mouth. Chew and swallow. Pick up the bowl with the left hand. Sip the soup. Put the bowl down. Talk to Member 1 about the day. Pick up more food with the chopsticks. Continue eating. Put the chopsticks down on the plate. Stand up. Walk to the refrigerator. Open the door. Take out a bottle of water. Close the door. Walk back to the table. Sit down. Pour water into a glass. Lift the glass. Drink.

enriched_activities.activity: Clearing the table and loading the dishwasher with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the chair. Pick up the plates with both hands. Carry the plates to the sink. Place the plates in the sink. Walk back to the table. Pick up the bowls. Carry the bowls to the sink. Pick up the chopsticks. Place them in the sink. Pick up the leftover bowl. Open the refrigerator door. Place the bowl inside. Close the refrigerator door. Pick up a sponge. Turn the tap on. Squeeze dish soap onto the sponge. Wipe the plates with the sponge. Rinse the plates under the water. Turn the tap off. Open the dishwasher door. Pull the lower rack out. Place the plates in the rack. Place the bowls in the rack. Place the chopsticks in the basket. Push the rack in. Add the detergent into the dispenser. Close the dishwasher door. Press the start button. Pick up the cloth. Wipe the table surface. Wipe the counter with the cloth. Turn to Member 1. Say: "Thanks for the help." Press the kitchen light switch off.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the living room. Walk to the sofa. Sit down on the sofa next to Member 1. Lean back against the cushion. Stretch both arms forward. Place the phone on the coffee table. Pick up the remote control from the table. Point the remote at the TV. Press the power button. Put the remote down on the cushion. Turn the head toward Member 1. Say: "How was your meeting today?" Listen to Member 1. Nod the head. Pick up the phone from the table. Tap the screen. Put the phone back on the table. Adjust the cushion behind the back.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and chatting with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up the remote control. Press the channel button. Put the remote down. Watch the screen. Turn the head to Member 1. Talk about the afternoon exhibition meeting. Point at the screen with the right hand. Laugh. Pick up the phone from the table. Show the phone screen to Member 1. Say: "Look at this illustration." Scroll the screen with the thumb. Put the phone back on the table. Pick up the glass of water. Sip the water. Put the glass down. Pick up the remote control. Press the volume button. Put the remote down. Lean back on the sofa. Cross the right leg over the left leg. Watch the screen. Turn the head to Member 1. Ask about tomorrow's schedule. Listen. Nod the head. Stand up from the sofa. Say: "I'll go do some drawing now."

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing freelance illustration work, sketching and digital coloring on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the bedroom. Pull the chair out from the desk. Sit down on the chair. Press the desk lamp switch on. Adjust the lamp arm toward the sketchbook. Press the computer power button on. Open the drawing software. Pick up the pencil from the desk. Open the sketchbook. Draw outline strokes on the paper with the pencil. Rotate the sketchbook. Draw the details of the figure. Put the pencil down. Pick up the phone. Take a photo of the sketch. Put the phone down. Connect the phone to the computer with the cable. Drag the photo file into the drawing software. Open the photo as the reference layer. Pick up the stylus pen. Draw lines on the drawing tablet. Fill the base colors with the brush tool. Switch to the shading brush. Apply shading on the character. Move the mouse to the color palette. Click a darker color. Continue coloring on the tablet. Press the shortcut keys for undo. Redraw the line with the stylus. Save the file. Click export. Type the file name on the keyboard. Press enter. Open the phone. Send the exported image as a message to the client. Put the phone down. Turn the chair toward the desk. Shut the computer down. Press the desk lamp switch off.

Stand up from the chair. Walk to the bathroom door. Push the door open. Step inside. Press the light switch on. Turn the water heater switch on. Turn the tap on. Hold both hands under the water. Rub the soap between the hands. Wash the face with both hands. Rinse the face with water. Pick up the towel from the hook. Wipe the face with the towel. Hang the towel back on the hook. Pick up the toothbrush. Turn the tap on. Hold the toothbrush under the water. Turn the tap off. Squeeze toothpaste onto the toothbrush. Lift the toothbrush to the mouth. Brush the teeth up and down. Spit into the sink. Turn the tap on. Rinse the mouth with water. Turn the tap off. Rinse the toothbrush under the water. Place the toothbrush into the holder. Turn the water heater switch off. Press the light switch off. Open the door. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading and planning tomorrow's tasks under the desk lamp
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the bedroom. Walk to the desk. Pull the chair out. Sit down on the chair. Press the desk lamp switch on. Pick up the notebook from the desk. Open the notebook to a blank page. Pick up the pen. Write tomorrow's task list in the notebook. Read the list. Draw a check mark beside the first item. Pick up the phone. Tap the calendar icon. Type the exhibition meeting time. Put the phone down. Pick up the novel from the desk. Open the book. Read the page. Turn the page with the right hand. Read the next page. Close the book. Place the book on the desk. Pick up the pen. Write one more item in the notebook. Close the notebook. Stand up. Walk to the bed. Pull the blanket back.

Sit down on the bed. Lie down on the back. Pull the blanket up over the body. Place the head on the pillow. Turn onto the right side. Bend the left arm under the pillow. Close the eyes. Pull the blanket up to the shoulders. Turn onto the back. Extend the legs. Turn onto the left side. Breathe slowly and evenly. Roll onto the stomach. Turn the head to the other side. Pull the blanket toward the chest. Remain lying still.
